name: mgs-forms
description: MGs Forms — MG form completion module for UK defence solicitors

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:api" "npm run start:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.render-regression: node tools/capture-reference-renders --out test-results/render-candidates && node tools/pixel-diff --baseline e2e/reference-renders --candidate test-results/render-candidates
